name: bug
description: Reported behavior differs from the intended behavior.

name: needs-triage
description: Needs maintainer reproduction, scope and priority review.

name: area:playback
description: Player, source resolution or queue behavior.

name: area:accounts
description: Login, account isolation or provider credentials.

name: area:crash
description: Crash, ANR, startup or installation failure.

name: priority:critical
description: Maintainer-confirmed security, data-loss or broad playback outage.

name: priority:high
description: Confirmed regression requiring the next corrective release.

name: priority:normal
description: Triaged issue without an urgent impact.

name: blocked
description: Waiting on a specific dependency, evidence or owner decision.
